title: ai_forecast version 2 will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
Starting in January 2027, [`ai_forecast` version 2](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/ai_forecast) will be available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled.

`ai_forecast` version 2 uses a foundation model for more accurate time series forecasts in SQL, and adds holidays, external covariates, and non-negative forecasts. Queries that don't specify a version continue to use version 1.
